item.description:
Notice: I do not offer hacking services

I don’t hack Facebook, Instagram, email, or any other accounts, and I never will. Breaking into someone else’s account is illegal and unethical, and it isn’t something I do for money, favors, or “just this once.”

If anyone tells you I can or will hack an account for you, they are lying, and you should not trust them. Anyone claiming to act on my behalf for this kind of work is scamming you. Never send money, personal details, or account info to someone using my name.

A terrible, terrible month for me on many fronts. However, I’m still here, still on board, and still not under indictment (that I know of). May will be better for me or I will set it on fire.

The time has come to move hosts. I’m now on a VPS that allows me the ability to do things like, offer SSL by default for free on my site, credits to where credits are due.
